blocks.text: Pelajaran ini tentang aturan dan saran: «dia harus menunjukkan identitas», «aku harus membaca kontrak», «sebaiknya kamu tanya guru», «tidak boleh mengabaikan aturan», «aku tidak perlu beli perlengkapan». Yang terpenting: jangan tertukar «tidak boleh» dan «tidak perlu».

examples.en: I have to read the contract.
I don't have to buy supplies.

blocks.text: must + kata kerja seperti di kamus — «harus», «wajib»: You must take your belongings. Must sama untuk semua, tanpa -s, dan setelahnya tidak pernah ada to.

examples.en: We must check the expiry date.

fixes.wrong: You must to take your belongings.

drill.why: Setelah must, kata kerja seperti di kamus: tanpa -s dan tanpa to.

blocks.text: have to + kata kerja — «harus», «terpaksa», sering karena keadaan: I have to read the contract. Dengan he / she pakai has to. Tanpa to artinya lain: I have read — «aku sudah membaca».

formula.text: I / you / we / they: have to + kata kerja
he / she: has to + kata kerja

examples.en: I have to read the contract.
She has to enter her occupation.
I occasionally have to work late.
He has to follow the diversion.
I have to show proof of purchase.

fixes.wrong: I has to read the contract.
fixes.right: I have to read the contract.

fixes.wrong: She have to enter her occupation.
fixes.right: She has to enter her occupation.

blocks.text: should + kata kerja adalah saran: «sebaiknya», «seharusnya». You should consult a teacher. Should juga tanpa -s dan tanpa to.

examples.en: We should use up the milk.

fixes.wrong: You should to consult a teacher.

blocks.text: ought to juga saran, hampir sama dengan should, tapi pakai to: You ought to set a budget — «semestinya kamu buat anggaran». Di sini to wajib, -s tidak.

examples.en: You ought to set a budget.
We ought to find the cause.
You ought to keep in mind the departure time.
We ought to express our gratitude.

fixes.wrong: You ought read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

fixes.wrong: You oughts to read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

drill.why: Setelah ought selalu ada to — beda dengan should dan must.

blocks.text: mustn't adalah larangan: «tidak boleh», «sama sekali jangan». You mustn't ignore the rules. Hati-hati: «tidak harus» itu don't have to, bukan mustn't. Setelah mustn't kata kerja tanpa to.

fixes.wrong: You mustn't to ignore the rules.

sections.title: don't have to dan needn't — «tidak perlu»

blocks.text: «Tidak harus, tidak perlu» — don't / doesn't have to atau needn't: I don't have to buy supplies; You needn't reply straight away. Ini bukan larangan! Larangan itu mustn't. Setelah needn't tanpa to, setelah don't have pakai to.

formula.text: tidak harus: don't / doesn't have to + kata kerja

examples.en: I don't have to buy supplies.
She doesn't have to bring a photocopy.
He doesn't have to head back yet.

fixes.wrong: She don't have to bring a photocopy.
fixes.right: She doesn't have to bring a photocopy.

fixes.wrong: I don't has to buy supplies.
fixes.right: I don't have to buy supplies.

fixes.wrong: You needn't to collect it personally.

drill.question: Cat di kelas melukis disediakan panitia. Kamu tidak perlu beli, tapi juga tidak dilarang. Kamu bilang apa?
drill.optionB: I don't have to buy supplies.
drill.explain: «Tidak perlu» — don't have to. Mustn't artinya «tidak boleh».

blocks.text: Permintaan sopan dari pelajaran 19 muncul juga di sini: Could I pay separately? — «boleh aku bayar terpisah?». Could dulu, lalu I dan kata kerja tanpa to.

examples.en: Could I send it by post?

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.wrong: You must to take your belongings.
I has to read the contract.
fixes.right: I have to read the contract.

fixes.wrong: You ought read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

fixes.wrong: You needn't to collect it personally.

blocks.text: to hanya ada di have to dan ought to. Setelah must, should, mustn't, dan needn't langsung kata kerja. Dilarang — mustn't, tidak perlu — don't have to atau needn't.
Wajib — must. Harus karena keadaan — have / has to. Saran — should atau ought to. Tidak boleh — mustn't. Tidak perlu — don't have to atau needn't.

examples.en: We must go through the list.
He should stand up for his friend.
